title: Does Online Fundraising Increase Charitable Giving? A Nationwide Field Experiment on Facebook
eligible_reason: Geo-randomized natural field experiment: about 8,000 German postal codes randomly assigned to a single 14-day Facebook video campaign (one common start date) or pure control. Main estimates (Tables 2-5, 7-9) are postal-code cross-sections: reghdfe donations_win_pm treatment donations_before $controls, absorb(blocknumber), i.e., treatment-period outcome on treatment with the lagged (pre-period) outcome, demographics and randomization-block FE; Table 3 uses first differences (dondif) on treatment. No staggered adoption, no unit-by-period panel with unit and time FE.
design_notes: Stata 16 reghdfe, robust SE. Short-term (14-day campaign) and long-term (52-day) cross-sections built by prepare_cross_section_*.do. Table A07 splits treatment into four video-by-targeting arms; Table 9 interacts treatment with median-split characteristics.
data_files_note: readme.pdf: data are proprietary and the folder contains no data; two of three datasets available on request from GESIS (doi 10.7802/2674) after signing an agreement.
screener_notes: Screened from package and OpenAlex abstract. Single-date randomized geo experiment analyzed in cross-section; no data shipped.
